---
title: "Contribute"
meta-description: "How to report issues, add genomes or proteins, correct taxonomy"
---

Contributions to VirMarkDB are welcome through GitHub issues and pull requests, including marker corrections, genome or protein additions, taxonomy updates, and documentation improvements.

## Issue tracker

Open an [issue](https://github.com/Est-oup/VirMarkDB/issues) for:

- suspicious or incorrect marker assignments
- missing taxa or poorly represented lineages
- requests for new marker groups
- questions about workflow provenance or reproducibility
- documentation corrections

## Pull request workflow

1. Open an issue describing the proposed change.
2. Fork the repository.
3. Create a dedicated branch.
4. Modify the relevant files.
5. Check metadata consistency (see checklist below).
6. Open a pull request referencing the issue.

## Adding reference proteins

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `marker` | Marker name matching an existing identifier |
| `protein_accession` | Protein accession or stable identifier |
| `source` | Source database, publication or curation source |
| `taxonomy` | ICTV-compatible taxonomy when possible |
| `reason` | Why this sequence should be added |

## Adding reference genomes

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `genome_accession` | Genome accession or stable identifier |
| `virus_name` | Virus name |
| `ICTV_ID` | ICTV identifier when available |
| `taxonomy` | Taxonomic assignment |
| `source` | Source database or publication |
| `reason` | Why this genome should be added |

## Metadata consistency checklist

Before opening a pull request:

- identifiers are stable and not session-specific
- marker names match existing identifiers in `mapfile.tsv`
- `group_id` and `marker_group_id` use lowercase identifiers without spaces
- taxonomy is consistent from Kingdom to Species
- missing taxonomy ranks are coded as `NA`
- added files are not cluster-specific
- `input/ncbi.creds` and other private credentials are never committed
